resolved_findings.title: Automatic WorkOS provisioning requires profile claims that standard AuthKit access tokens do not contain
resolved_findings.resolution: The official @convex-dev/workos-authkit component now owns JWT provider configuration and signature-verifying webhook routes. Verified user.created/user.updated events synchronize profile fields; user.deleted disables rather than deletes the app user. users.store accepts no arguments, requires tokenIdentifier plus subject, and binds only an active identitySource=workos_webhook profile for that exact subject. WorkOS role/org claims create no membership or grant. A missing/placeholder webhook secret receives a per-isolate cryptographically random fail-closed value rather than a source-known secret.
